prefilter.note: Lenient quote pre-filter (50 symbols per quote call) before any history call. Always fetched: CORE, yesterday's watchlist and Layer B set, symbols without a quote. Names the full screen rejected as illiquid are re-checked weekly.

layerB.note: Bench = anomaly scanner scan set: the next N names by score that missed the watchlist (eligible, bar on the as-of date). The engine subscribes watchlist (cap 60) + bench + Nifty; Fyers Standard allows 100 symbols per user, options are off until the expiry fix, so the total is at most 91. Owner's choice (b), 2026-10-21.
